body.name: Fourier-separated mixed-noise class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M(p,\lambda,\Lambda,c,C,Q,M_8,q,\preceq)=\{P_X:X=U+G_\Gamma,\ U=AH,\ U\perp G_\Gamma,\ \lambda I\preceq\Gamma\preceq\Lambda I,\ \Gamma\text{ is the greatest Gaussian divisor of }P_X,\ 1\le k\le p,\ H_1,\ldots,H_k\text{ are mutually independent, nonconstant, Gaussian-indecomposable, and unit variance},\ \operatorname{rank}(A)=k,\text{ the first nonzero entry of each column of }A\text{ is positive, the columns are in ascending lexicographic order},\ c(1+|t|)^{-q_u}\le|\phi_U(tu)|\le C(1+|t|)^{-q_u}\text{ for every }u\in\mathcal R\text{ and }|t|\ge1,\ \mathbb E\|X\|^8\le M_8,\ \preceq\text{ is a known strict partial order}\}\).
